name: Screen capture crop
summary: A cropped capture of an interface that keeps the frame of the original, so the text reads as found, not made.
how: Capture the post card at its native width of 550 to 600px.
Crop to the card and leave a few pixels of the next item.
Keep the compression of the original; do not sharpen.
Keep the interface colours; do not add a frame.

origin.note: Users share cropped captures of posts outside their site, as proof of what a person wrote.

adoptions.via: Humour accounts turn the post screenshot into a main joke form.
